notes.title: The Future of Night Poetry
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

One month ago, I launched this game. I never thought I would receive so much support when I started the development, so I am very happy with every gameplay I watch. Thank you so much!

I thought it would be great to make the future of Night Poetry public, so here is a roadmap:

I am planning a major update with lots of cool stuff, including new music and a completely new section in the game, enhancing all its aspects!

Along with this, I plan to add the music room, a dedicated space to listen to the soundtrack with a brief commentary on what was on my mind during its composition—an idea I originally discarded at the beginning of the development due to the limited number of tracks in the current soundtrack (it will increase, I promise!).

That's it! I don't have any dates yet, but I hope you enjoy it!

All the best,
Rodrigo
